note.quote: I’m the kind of dev who opens Figma before the IDE. To me, a great interface is first and foremost a consistent one: everything lands where you expect it, and using it just feels good without quite knowing why.
note.text: As a lead, I set the frame so the team can move fast without the code going off in every direction. And when there’s a little room left, I slip in a detail that makes people smile… you may have already found one here.

skills.title: Team spirit
skills.text: Solo at 2 a.m. or unblocking a teammate, both suit me fine.

skills.title: Curiosity
skills.text: A new library, a fuzzy concept? I open a tab and dig in.

skills.title: Adaptability
skills.text: New stack, new context: I adapt fast without cutting corners.

skills.title: Passion
skills.text: Dev isn’t just a job… I’d be coding on weekends anyway.
